# Depot shift guide

## Morning checks

Walk the racks before the first riders arrive and note any bike with a
flat tyre or a loose basket. Log each one on the depot tablet so the
repair bench knows what to expect by eight.

## Charging

Swap every battery that reads under forty percent and put the drained
ones on the wall chargers in bay two. Chargers take about three hours, so
start the first batch before you do anything else.

## Repairs

Bikes flagged in the morning go to the repair bench in the order they
were logged. If a part is out of stock, tag the bike red and leave it in
the back row until the supplier delivers.

## Handover

Before you leave, count the bikes in each rack and compare the total with
the evening dispatch list. Report anything missing to the duty manager by
phone before you clock off for the night.
